evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/b/a extends R148 PluginPanel and owns ConfigManager, PluginManager, PluginListPanel, fixed-width config content, enum renderers, color/hotkey controls and the currently selected PluginConfigurationDescriptor.

The class materializes ConfigDescriptor/ConfigItemDescriptor/ConfigSectionDescriptor metadata into Swing controls for booleans, integer ranges, text, colors, enums, hotkeys and list values, persisting edits through ConfigManager.

RuneLite ConfigPanel extends PluginPanel and has the same plugin/config dependencies, descriptor-driven control creation, section expansion, reset behavior and config value widgets represented by exact v308.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/b/o extends JPanel and implements R238 SearchablePlugin; it owns one PluginConfigurationDescriptor, keyword list, enable/pin toggle controls and config/open controls.
Its SearchablePlugin methods expose the descriptor name, keywords and pinned state consumed directly by R238 PluginSearch.
RuneLite PluginListItem extends JPanel implements SearchablePlugin and owns the same plugin descriptor, pin/toggle/config UI behavior and searchable name/keyword/pinned contract.

evidence.detail: Exact v308 rs/s/b/q extends R148 PluginPanel, preserves the exact config key 'pinnedPlugins', owns PluginManager/ConfigManager, a Provider<ConfigPanel>, PluginConfigurationDescriptor list and PluginListItem list.
The panel filters through R238 PluginSearch, persists pinned plugin names, rebuilds plugin list items, opens ConfigPanel for a selected descriptor and refreshes on PluginChanged events.

RuneLite PluginListPanel extends PluginPanel and preserves the same PINNED_PLUGINS_CONFIG_KEY='pinnedPlugins', PluginManager, Provider<ConfigPanel>, searchable list/pin persistence and PluginListItem construction flow.
